title: About
intro: The platform was built to unify a company's data, processes and reports in one system, replacing scattered spreadsheets.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Help every department work from the same data, with clear processes and permissions that match each role.

items.clarity: Clear: a consistent interface with just enough information density to read comfortably.
items.performance: Fast: instant page loads, tuned for low-end devices and slow networks.
items.access: Accessible: fully usable with a keyboard and readable by screen readers.
